title: teucrium divaricatum subsp. athoum
intro: Teucrium divaricatum subsp. athoum, commonly known as Rock Tea, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, scientifically classified as a subspecies of the Teucrium divaricatum plant. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Rock Tea include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
